Before you book

Why a £10 deposit?

It holds your chair and comes off the bill at the end. If you cannot come, tell us a day ahead and it comes back to you.

What if I am late?

Up to ten minutes is fine. After that we may have to shorten the cut or move you to the next free chair.

When should I book my next cut?

A fade looks its best for about three weeks. Book at the end of the cut and you keep your usual slot.

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes, whenever a chair is free. Booking just means you never have to find out.

How do I pay?

The £10 deposit goes on a card when you book. The rest is paid at the chair, by card or cash.
